BYNTA-I. 

KA JINGLAMPHRANG: 

Ka Kur Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang, ka la iar bad bun briew 
shibun ha kane ka Ri Khasi. Ki briew na kane ka kur kila don ha 
kylleng ki jaka jong ka Ri Khasi, Jaintia. 

Ki briew jong kane ka jait Lyngkhoi Thangmyisiang ki ju thoh 
ialade ha ki Certificate School, bad ha kiwei de ki jingdonkam tang 
da ka kyntien Lyngkhoi. Kumta haba nga thoh ia kane kakot lehse 
kan pynpyrkhat iangi mynta, kaei kaktirai bang! dei baniryndraikam. 

Kaba phylla ka long haba nga poi ha kiba bun ki jingialang 
Kur, ki pyndonkam ruh da ka kyntien ‘Lyngkhei’ hynrei ki ba bun pat 
de ki briew na kane ka kpoh ki thoh ha ki jingdonkam jong ki da ka 
kyntien ‘Lyngkhoi’. Halor jong kane ka jingiapher haka rukom thoh, 
nga kwah ban ia pashat jingmut lem. Kum u nongthoh haba nga ialeh 
ban wad nangno kane ka Kur Lyngkhoi Thangmyisiang ka mih?.

Ka Jait Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang ka mih nyn^ong eh qa Id 
thain Sepngi jong ka Ri Khasi. Haba phai sha ki amgut ki kmiebah 
tymmen; kata ka Me Long bad Me Khrei, kiba dei shipara trai. kine 
amgut ki mih na ki thain Nongsynrieh, Shngimawlein, ne Laitnong. 
kumba kapawha ki khanapateng bad ki wan buhai shncnighapohka 
shnong Mawten jong ka (Maharam ^emship).I&baphai dta kine ki 
jaka,ngi shem bakane kal^nden’Lyn^dKH’badkakynden ‘lyi^jldiBi’ki 
long kajuh ka jingmut. kim don jingi^her d ei ha kajingmuii^fqd 
ka jingiapher kadei tang ka ktien (Dialect) jong kawei kajaka badkft 
wei pat. Ka ktien Maram ka i^her na ka ktien Mawiang. Ka ktien 




Mawiangkaiapher nakaktien Sohiongbadkumtaterter. Ladangin 
peit bniah, sha ki ktien jong ki jaka kiba hap ha ki thain sepngi jong 
kane ka Ri Khasi wat la kirn da paw eh ha kathoh katar hynrei ngi 
shem ba ym dei tang ka ktien Lyngkhoi ne Lyngkhei ba ki briew ki 
pyndonkam. Ki don shibun kiwei pat kum ka ktien’Langkhei’ne 
‘Longkhoi’, bad kiwei de. 


Kumba nga la kynthoh ba don shibun kiba na kane ka jait ki 
pyndonkam ia ka ktien Lyngkhoi bad ym j u kham don koit kiba thoh 
Lyngkhoi Hiangmyrsiang ne Lyngkhei Thangmyrsiang, kane kan sa 
wanrah ia ka jingklumar ne ka jingsngewpher bad lah ban don ruh 
kiba sngewbakim dei shikur. Haba nga thoh ia kane kakot^gakwah 
ban kyrsiew bad ban buh jingkynmaw ia ki longdien bad mandien 
kiban sa bud pateng la pateng. Lada ngi la thoh ne pyndonkam da ka 
ktien Lyngkhoi, Lyngkhei, Longkhoi ne Langkhei ialade.Kat ki ba mih 
na kane ka Tyllong 'Thangmyrsiang* ia ki ba ki longshwa ki la jer ki 
la nam ngim dei ban ong ne nie w ba ngi don j ingiapher. Ka long nih ka 
bym bit ban shongkha Lyngkhei bad Lyngkhoi haba ngi mih na kane 
kajuhka ‘Thymmei’. Thangmyrsiang.

BYNTA-II. 




Kl TYLLONGs 

Ki don shibun ki jait ha ka Ri Khasi Jaintia, kum ka jait 
Lyngdoh, jait Kharkongor, jait Marwein bad kiwei kiwei de. kajait 
Lyngkhoi ka long kawei nakibabun ki jait, baki longshwaman^wa 
kila jer kila nam kumba leh ia kiwei kiwei pat ki para kur ki para jait 
ba don haka Ri Khasi jong ngi. 


Haba ngi phai sha kajait Lyngkhoi kaba ki para jait jong ka kur 
Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang ki thoh lane iathuh ialade ha ki briew ialaka 
jong kajait. Hynrei ngi shetn pat ba kajait Lyngkhoi ka don bun tnad, 
kum ka Lyngkhoi Niuh, Lyngdoh Lyngkhoi, Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang 
Lyngkhoi Myriem, Lyngkhoi Ladew, Lyngkhoi Shrieh bad kiwei de.Kum 
u nongthoh haba wad bniah shaphang ka kur Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang, 
kala don ne em ka jingiadei bad kite! kiwei pat ki tnad, tad haduh mynta 
ym pat lah ban pyntikna, ki longkni ruh kirn lah ban ai ka jubab kaba shai 
ia ki dei shikur, bad la ki hiar pateng na kajuh ka kmie ne em. 

Haba wad bniah ia ka tyllong ba tynrai jong kane ka kur 
Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang nangno ka mih?.

Ki Khanajong ki tymmoi ki san, ki iathuh, bahakapor kaba 
mynhyndaikulongkumah, ladon kawei ka briew bad kane kabiiew 
kashaitleitthohdiengnakhlawmanlakasngi. Kimmorekuninokane 
ka briew ka la ia shongkha bad u Myrsiang, Kumta ka la punkhiui. 
Haba bald kmie ki kpajki kni, ki laltylli bniah kala phlabaka Id pun 
khun na u Myrsiang. Kumta ki kni, ki kmie ki kpa, ki la Idh mam leh 
rukom. Ki la pyndep iaka lehniam leh rukom daka bai^iah leit kem 
ruh ia u ta u Myrsiang na khlaw. Hadien ba ki la pyndep ia ka leh niaot 



leh rukom, ki la suit la j er bad la ka nam ia ka bad ki khun jong ka da 
ka jait Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang, bad haduh mynta mynne ia ki briew 
bahiarpatengnaka, lajeriakikumkajait Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang. 

Ha ka ba pyrkhat bad puson shaphang kane ka khana-tang, 
ngam lah ban pynshisha la ka dei ne em namar hato ka lah ban long ba 
u Myrsiang u ia shongkha bad ka briew?. Bad haba ia shongkha, ka 
briew bad u Mrad, hato yn kha Briew ne Mrad?. 

Shisien pyrkhat U Briew bad U Mrad, ki don ka j ingiapher ka 
bakhraw. Hynrei ym lah ban tip ia ka bor maia, ba phylla, jong ka por 
barim bajah, haba ki briew ki dang ngeit ha ka niam (Chasi tynrai. 
Haba peit ia Id dak ki shin, kum ki Mawphor, bad ki wei kiwei de ym 
lah ban mutdur ba ki lah ban ring ia ki Mawphor tang da u thnieng 
pathaw. Kumta katei ka khana ka shong hanga bad haphi, ki para kur 
bad para jait ba ngin pynshong nongrim, la ka lah ban dei ne em. 

Kawei pat ka khana pateng, kaba shem haba wad bniah, 
sh^hang ka tyllong jong ka kur “ Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang” ka 
long ba ha kawei ka por mynhyndai da ki bun pateng bynriew ba 
mynshwa la don kawei ka Briew, kaba don Saw ngutkildiunKynthei, 
bad ka la don ka pen* ba leh niam, leh rukom, kumta kineki Saw ngut

shipara kiba la don la ka jong ka jong ka ling, bad la ki jong ki khun ki 
ksiew, kala waniah laki jong kijingai na ka bynta ban knia, ban pyndep 
ia ka leh niam leh rukom, kum ki Blang, ki Syiar, Kba bad kumta ter 
ter. 

Kawd nakine ki saw ngut shiparakala wan rah ban leh niam,

Haka ba wad ia ka jingshisha, na ki kni jong ka kur Lyngkhoi 
Thangmyrsiang kpoh jong ka Me Long, la hato ka don ne em kaba 
kumkaneka jingshisha. Hatokilongkni bamynshwakikheinneem 
ba ka jait Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang, ka dang ia dei shi kur bad ka jait 
Lyngdoh Nonglait, Jait Lyngdoh Lynkien, Jait Sawkmie. Kat kum ki 
longkni jong katei ka kpoh Me Long, kim shymlah ban pynshisha, 
namar ym shym la don ruh kano kano ka jingiathuh khana, lane ka 
jingbdiahjongki longkni, baka kur Lyngkhoi Thangmyrsiang ka dang 
iadei shikur bad kitei ki Lai Jait ki longkni jong ki kni jong ngi, naduh 
mynshwa bad kum ba ka paw haduh mynta ki la shah ia ki ba kin ia 
shongkha bad kitei ki Lai Jait. 

Haduh, ba nga buh ia kane ka j ingthoh kum ka kur Lyngkhoi 
Thangmyrsiang Iqxshjong ka Me Long, ki bud iakaei kaba ki longkni 
ki la leh mynshwa, ba kim lah ban shim ba ka kur Lyngkhoi 
Thangmyrsiang ka dei shikur bad ka kur Lyngdoh Nonglait Lyngdoh
